subject: general
question: Who won the Bronze medal in badminton women's singles at Tokyo Olympics 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Sindhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badminton women's singles at Tokyo Olympics 2020**

 
 
• The **2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics women's singles badminton **competition took place in the **Musashino Forest Sport Plaza in Tokyo **from 24 July to 1 August. 
 
• There were **43 competitors** overall from 37 different countries.
 
• After **winning bronze at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, **PV Sindhu became the first woman from India to win two Olympic medals**.
 
• At the Tokyo Olympics on **August 1, 2021**, experienced Indian badminton player PV Sindhu d**efeated China's He Bingjiao **to earn the women's singles bronze medal.
 
• Prior to that, at the **2016 Rio Olympics women's singles badminton**, she won the **silver medal**.
 
• PV Sindhu's full name is** Pusarla Venkata Sindhu, **an **Indian badminton player** who was born on July 5, 1995.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **President Ram Nath Kovind**, who was thrilled with her performance at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, **praised her for creating a new standard for reliability, dedication, and performance**.
 
• **A Se-young**, a badminton player from Gwangju in **South Korea**, was awarded as the** BWF (Badminton World Federation) Most Promising Player of the Year for 2019**.
 
• In the women's singles badminton competition at the Tokyo Olympics, **Chen Yu Fei of China defeated Tai Tzu-Ying of Taiwan to win the gold medal**.
 
• Taiwanese badminton player **Tai Tzu-Ying** won the **gold medal at the 2017 Summer Universiade** and the **2018 Asian Games** in addition to the **silver medal in the women's singles event at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
